Do not treat 0.1.3-experimental as a pass. Same-unit card of 0.1.3 (ELEK PS 0.1.3, SHA-256 09911ff850c5062e37d471ff53a0ca196e14db1a9537dd00cc4459b7413107fb): PLAY START is stable in PERSONALIZE and YES ticks or clears it, but with X showing [PLAY] still paused and continued from the pause point. 0.1.3 wrote POS0/POS1=-1 then jumped to 0x40061856; stock 0x400a030c RTS when POS0<0, so that path stopped without starting. Ticked [PLAY] jsr'd stock sequencer STOP 0x400a10c8 then 0x400a030c with pea 0. Same-unit card of 0.1.4 (ELEK PS 0.1.4, SHA-256 945b6fe5dffbefb32a6a0696610d12deb3c55cafe4ad3874a4e85a67b0491285): [PLAY] still paused when X'd. Not a pass; see 0.1.5-experimental.

Do not treat 0.1.2-experimental as a pass. Same-unit report: 0.1.2 made no difference whatsoever (or it was not possible to tell the image installed; OS stamp was still PLAYSTART). 0.1.0-0.1.2 stored PLAY START at 0x800000e0, which is the live frame-builder ping (toggles every audio frame). That made the checkbox fight a stock bit, so YES looked temperamental, arrows seemed to undo X, and [PLAY] almost always saw 0 and paused. The row now uses the free PERSONALIZE word 0x800000dc and ANDY shadow 0x100fff6c (same exclusive slot Mute Modes uses; ANDY pea 0x64 -> 0x70). wrap=0 still does not store; wrap=1 (YES) toggles. Same-unit card of 0.1.3 (ELEK PS 0.1.3, SHA-256 09911ff850c5062e37d471ff53a0ca196e14db1a9537dd00cc4459b7413107fb): checkbox stable, YES toggles; [PLAY] still paused when X'd because POS0=-1 makes 0x400a030c RTS. Not a pass; see 0.1.4-experimental.

Do not treat 0.1.1-experimental as a pass. Same-unit card retest of 0.1.1 (SHA-256 60c74be9b26cfe39fd69330b03b46543e5038c9b45cf09b26a2239e87b3bc2b6): empty box appeared; YES sometimes put an X but was temperamental; arrows still undid the X; with X showing, [PLAY] still paused. Setter wrap=0 returned without a store; wrap=1 toggled 0x800000e0. [PLAY] while ticked did stock STOP words then 0x40061856. Same-unit report of the 0.1.2 card: no difference whatsoever (stamp was still PLAYSTART, so install was not distinguishable). Not a pass; see 0.1.3-experimental.

Card flash on a unit: PLAY START drew as OFF/ON text, cursor up/down ticked it, and [PLAY] still paused when ON. The row is now a stock checkbox (empty / X). The setter subtracted LEVEL like QUANTIZE LIVE REC so scrolling PERSONALIZE would not change it. [PLAY] while ticked jumped to stock's stopped start path instead of the pause helper. Same-unit retest of the 0.1.1 card (SHA-256 60c74be9b26cfe39fd69330b03b46543e5038c9b45cf09b26a2239e87b3bc2b6): glyphs worked, but YES was temperamental, arrows still cleared X, and [PLAY] still paused when X showed. Not a pass; see 0.1.3-experimental.

First version: PERSONALIZE PLAY START (OFF/ON, default OFF). When ON, panel [PLAY] starts the sequencer from the beginning instead of pausing or continuing. Conflicts with Mute Modes. Hardware and emulator behaviour are not tested.
